Lion Mutilation: King of the Beasts Butchered

By: Joy Summers | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
As South African children are enthralled by the latest Lion King movie, in reality lions are in deep, deep trouble. Aside from canned hunting, the bone trade they are now poisoned and hacked

Unique Selling Point:
Visuals and people prepared to tell their stories - details for the first time of the some of the criminals involved in this barbaric crime

Summary:
Prized now, not as a top predator, but rather as a bag of bones for the Asian market, our lions are the targets of a double jeopardy.
If they don’t get bred for their bones, or shot by a canned hunter, they are being poisoned and hacked to pieces for their teeth for trinkets for the Asian market.

Summary
Across the country, horrific images of lions with no paws, tails or heads are surfacing on social media. Once would have been bad enough but it now seems that over 100 lions in various attacks on private farms have shocked their owners and the public. Initially it was thought these lions were for the muti market, but it now seems organised crime syndicates are at the heart of this brutality – and some recent arrests may shed light on who is involved.


Further information:
This week Gert Blom of Predators rock in Rustenburg had eight of his lions killed. Before that in 2019 – Nazeer Cajee had 13 of his lions poisoned and hacked to pieces.

For a while no one did anything – owners of lions are sometimes breeders and canned hunters themselves and want to stay under the radar. But now those owners have begun to fight back against these barbaric criminals.

Enter Matty Van Eck who has a small private zoo in Midrand. She had sent two lions to a reserve in the Masai Mara – and those lions were also mutilated. By November Matty decided to do something to try and at least get some information that may lead to arrests. . She sent out a WhatsApp to all lion owners and invited them to answer her questionnaire. Two things have stood out as common to all the attacks. The first is that Two step is being used and the second more curious fact is that a week before each of the attacks took place, Nature conservation officials visited the premises to do inspections.

While that has not led to any arrests yet – two other people in their WhatsApp Group have taken action -Nazeer and Gert. Once before a water tight case was lost in the Koster court – there was DNA evidence and it appears the prosecutor didn’t even open the file.

On Monday Gert Blom received information about the perpetrators who killed eight of his lions. He bypassed the ordinary cops in the area and brought in organised crime investigators. They set up a sting and caught some of the perpetrators whose case has been postponed. They did not get bail and are still behind bars.

Even the United Nations have picked up on this story and we can speak to their lead researcher via skype – Daniel Styles.

Script:


LIONS 2020 FINAL SCRIPT FOR TX SUNDAY 19th JAN 2020

Commentary One
Somewhere around 2014 a gruesome wildlife crime began to surface. Poachers had found a fresh target - lions in captivity.

What they want are their teeth and their claws, and they will stop at nothing to get them

It’s as easy as throwing a poisoned chicken over a fence. Then waiting for the lions to stop moving.

That is what happened to Gert Blom’s lions in November 2018. Two were poisoned but swift action by his vet saved one of them

Gert
We put a pipe through his nose right into his stomach and poured 5 litres of activated charcoal inside the lions stomach – charcoal gets all the poison together and then we woke up lion and he starts vomiting. It was two step.

Commentary two
He was devastated, but his nightmare was far from over. Three days into 2020 poachers returned and butchered 8 of his lions for their teeth and paws.

Up sound:
Dis wat gisterrand gebeur het

Gert
Just the front part of the face. The teeth and all 32 paws. Nothing else.

Commentary three
The poachers had scaled three high fences, and 3 brick walls to get to his lions

Gert
You can’t believe the level of cruelty when they butchered those lions, it makes you not just angry, it kills something in you. It’s actually murder

Up sound Gert
En die mense wat dit doen- lafhards!

Commentary Four
The only survivor of this bloody scene was this little cub

Gert
And when the vet opened the lions so we could have samples of the poison that was used three of the other lions were pregnant




LINK MAC
I have felt a very strong bond with these big cats since I was a kid….. our family crest is Taung, and even looking at these pictures is difficult, one wants to turn away but if we do turn away, what then?

Commentary five
Matty van Eck is an owner of the Lory Park Zoo in Midrand.

Up sound with lion: hello my boy!

In 2018 two of her lions, Ice and Indra were mutilated, after she sold them to a wildlife lodge. So she put out a questionnaire to the industry to see if she could find something to link all the crimes together

Mac
You are not a policeman Matty, why is it up to you to do this?
Matty
I noticed in the past it was kept very quiet and you didn’t see very much about it in the news. I just felt like it was kept under the covers. You know everybody felt like they went to the police and that is where it ended. It was all falling on deaf ears

Commentary six
The police say that these claws and teeth are trafficked to the east, and they’re here in the Muthi trade, some for protection in crimes like cash in transit heists. But information is sketchy

MATTY
There was a lot in common, so it was the poisoning, they found ways of getting around security everything was common ground – we don’t know if it’s the same people it’s the same modus operandi

Commentary seven
There are an estimated 7000 lions in captivity in South Africa- many of those are bred for the bullet or the bone trade. These lions are not part of an eco- system, says nature conservation lecturer, and chair of the African lion working group, Dr Kelly Marnewick

Dr Kelly Marnewick
One of the biggest problems we have is that this captive lion industry exists, its putting a huge burden on our law enforcement and authorities and the NSPCA to regulate it, there is no conservation value and its providing a drive through for lion parts for these poachers

Commentary eight
The NSPCA wildlife unit, has seen its fair share of lions kept in horrific conditions. As the custodians of their welfare, the NSPCA opposes lions in captivity. Douglas Wolhuter heads up the wildlife unit.

DOUGLAS
These lions are sitting ducks, we have pulled figures and more than 90 % of the time they are being poisoned with Two step, and suffering absolutely horrific deaths and possibly mutilated while still alive
MAC
Douglas is there anything the NSPCA can do to try prevent these crimes?
DOUGLAS
I think what we have to get done is we have to get prosecutions. All of the cases we have looked at there we have about 7 arrests out of all of the cases and we haven’t seen too many successful convictions and it’s got to start there …people need to sit in jail.

Commentary nine
But that isn’t happening, there are arrests but then the cases are withdrawn.
In 2019 these Vietnamese nationals were arrested. They were allegedly in possession of 103 rhino horns and four tiger carcasses, but the Vietnamese were deported and the case was provisionally withdrawn against the South Africans

Nazeer Cajee’s story is another case in point.

Up sound Nazeer with leopard and black panther

As a young boy he was obsessed with animals, and would stand at the entrance to a circus watching them inside the tent.

Lock opens
It was whites only and he wasn’t allowed in.

Now years later he has his own predator Park just outside Rustenburg, and he can get as close as he likes to his animals.

Up sound lion greet

Commentary ten
Cajee has been criticized by animal activists opposed to predator parks like his, but he says he has nothing to hide, and Nature conservation actually use his facility for rescue’s, and there is no doubt, Nazeer Cajee has a bond with his animals

Up sound Nazeer to hyena: you are getting heavy now!

Commentary eleven
He has lost lions in two separate attacks and he wants to highlight how the justice system fails wildlife

NAZEER
It’s an extremely painful death from what we see, it can’t move, there is diarrhea and vomiting and they can’t move and when you do open the carcass it looks like the heart and the lungs exploded on the inside….. It’s extremely emotional … cries… you don’t know how to handle it.

Commentary twelve
In 2014 seven of Cajee’s lions were killed. He managed to save one. He put out a reward, hired a PI and organised crime arrested two suspects.

Nazeer Cajee
They found the bones buried on the property, with an eye witness who testified to say she saw the owner of the property burying the bones, and upon further investigation they found the panga or knife hidden away in his garage with blood stains on it, so we had the DNA to prove they used that knife to kill that lion, we had cell phone records to prove they were on my property at two in the morning, we had footprints and we had an eye witness and it went to court and it got thrown out of court for insufficient evidence. From what I understand they didn’t even read through the docket – they just threw it out of court – and three days later after the poachers were released they killed another five lions in Thabazimbi.

LINK
So there hasn’t been much in the way of intelligence about these poaching events. It seems they are on the increase – so we have tried to pin down the most accurate numbers – but that hasn’t been an exact science

Commentary Fourteen
Douglas Wolhuter has been trying to collate the numbers from some of the police statistics

Douglas
We have from 2017 – 2019 we got a number of 67 animals, the police say 61 animals, but often excluded TIGERS

Commentary fifteen
Dr Kelly Marnewick has also been collecting publicly available data
Kelly
We are losing about 20 odd captive lions per year.

Commentary sixteen
Those in the industry dispute these numbers and say it’s a lot more. But while the numbers are important, Marnewick is asking a different question

Dr Kelly Marnewick
It really is quite gut wrenching but the question I ask often though, is that people get very upset lions for their body parts, but many of these lions were anyway being bred for the canned lion hunting or their bones, but we seem to be more disgusted with their faces and feet cut off than by making a mat out of them for a hunting trophy




Commentary Seventeen
When Gert Blom alerted law enforcement about the crime against his lions two weeks ago, the Hawks acted swiftly. So we asked their spokesperson Col Katlego Mogale what happened.

Col Mogale
The members of the DPCI and serious organised crime in NW received information that there were people that were selling lion paws. Four people were arrested originally and further information sell to someone and eventually they arrested another four people of which two were Botswana nationals

GERT
I think we are at the beginning of something. Let’s just believe and not stop. Let’s see if we can get these guys

Commentary eighteen
But even though the police did their job, the prosecutors failed to do theirs. On Wednesday the state didn’t bother to oppose bail and the suspects paid a paltry maximum of R3000 bail, and walked out of the Rustenburg magistrates court. The NPA did not respond to our questions about this case, or why there appears to be not a single successful prosecution of any of the lion butchers.

THE END 10 01

PROMO ONE
Poaching of captive lions is back in the news after 8 lions were hacked on a farm earlier this month.
Gert
Just the front part of the face. The teeth and all 32 paws.


PROMO TWO
Captive lions are vulnerable to poachers who poison and butcher them for their paws and their teeth. Suspects are arrested but convictions are few and far between


PROMO THREE
A crime of unimaginable cruelty as lions are killed for their teeth and claws
Nazeer Cajee
when you do open the carcass it looks like the heart and the lungs exploded on the inside…

Up sound lion greet Commentary ten Cajee has been criticized by animal activists opposed to predator parks like his, but he says he has nothing to hide, and Nature conservation actually use his facility for rescue’s, and there is no doubt, Nazeer Cajee has a bond with his animals Up sound Nazeer to hyena: you are getting heavy now! Commentary eleven He has lost lions in two separate attacks and he wants to highlight how the justice system fails wildlife NAZEER It’s an extremely painful death from what we see, it can’t move, there is diarrhea and vomiting and they can’t move and when you do open the carcass it looks like the heart and the lungs exploded on the inside….. It’s extremely emotional … cries… you don’t know how to handle it. Commentary twelve In 2014 seven of Cajee’s lions were killed. He managed to save one. He put out a reward, hired a PI and organised crime arrested two suspects. Nazeer Cajee They found the bones buried on the property, with an eye witness who testified to say she saw the owner of the property burying the bones, and upon further investigation they found the panga or knife hidden away in his garage with blood stains on it, so we had the DNA to prove they used that knife to kill that lion, we had cell phone records to prove they were on my property at two in the morning, we had footprints and we had an eye witness and it went to court and it got thrown out of court for insufficient evidence. From what I understand they didn’t even read through the docket – they just threw it out of court – and three days later after the poachers were released they killed another five lions in Thabazimbi. LINK So there hasn’t been much in the way of intelligence about these poaching events. It seems they are on the increase – so we have tried to pin down the most accurate numbers – but that hasn’t been an exact science Commentary Fourteen Douglas Wolhuter has been trying to collate the numbers from some of the police statistics Douglas We have from 2017 – 2019 we got a number of 67 animals, the police say 61 animals, but often excluded TIGERS Commentary fifteen Dr Kelly Marnewick has also been collecting publicly available data Kelly We are losing about 20 odd captive lions per year. Commentary sixteen Those in the industry dispute these numbers and say it’s a lot more. But while the numbers are important, Marnewick is asking a different question Dr Kelly Marnewick It really is quite gut wrenching but the question I ask often though, is that people get very upset lions for their body parts, but many of these lions were anyway being bred for the canned lion hunting or their bones, but we seem to be more disgusted with their faces and feet cut off than by making a mat out of them for a hunting trophy Commentary Seventeen When Gert Blom alerted law enforcement about the crime against his lions two weeks ago, the Hawks acted swiftly. So we asked their spokesperson Col Katlego Mogale what happened. Col Mogale The members of the DPCI and serious organised crime in NW received information that there were people that were selling lion paws. Four people were arrested originally and further information sell to someone and eventually they arrested another four people of which two were Botswana nationals GERT I think we are at the beginning of something. Let’s just believe and not stop. Let’s see if we can get these guys Commentary eighteen But even though the police did their job, the prosecutors failed to do theirs. On Wednesday the state didn’t bother to oppose bail and the suspects paid a paltry maximum of R3000 bail, and walked out of the Rustenburg magistrates court. The NPA did not respond to our questions about this case, or why there appears to be not a single successful prosecution of any of the lion butchers. THE END 10 01 PROMO ONE Poaching of captive lions is back in the news after 8 lions were hacked on a farm earlier this month. Gert Just the front part of the face. The teeth and all 32 paws. PROMO TWO Captive lions are vulnerable to poachers who poison and butcher them for their paws and their teeth. Suspects are arrested but convictions are few and far between PROMO THREE A crime of unimaginable cruelty as lions are killed for their teeth and claws Nazeer Cajee when you do open the carcass it looks like the heart and the lungs exploded on the inside… Invoicing Back references from Insert ID in Invoice: Title Author Last Updated Invoice for Lion Mutilation: King of the Beasts Butchered (5608) Joy Summers 21 January 2020

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): As South African children are enthralled by the latest Lion King movie, in reality lions are in deep, deep trouble. Aside from canned hunting, the bone trade they are now poisoned and hacked
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Visuals and people prepared to tell their stories - details for the first time of the some of the criminals involved in this barbaric crime
metadata.Summary: Prized now, not as a top predator, but rather as a bag of bones for the Asian market, our lions are the targets of a double jeopardy. If they don’t get bred for their bones, or shot by a canned hunter, they are being poisoned and hacked to pieces for their teeth for trinkets for the Asian market. Summary Across the country, horrific images of lions with no paws, tails or heads are surfacing on social media. Once would have been bad enough but it now seems that over 100 lions in various attacks on private farms have shocked their owners and the public. Initially it was thought these lions were for the muti market, but it now seems organised crime syndicates are at the heart of this brutality – and some recent arrests may shed light on who is involved.
metadata.Further information: This week Gert Blom of Predators rock in Rustenburg had eight of his lions killed. Before that in 2019 – Nazeer Cajee had 13 of his lions poisoned and hacked to pieces. For a while no one did anything – owners of lions are sometimes breeders and canned hunters themselves and want to stay under the radar. But now those owners have begun to fight back against these barbaric criminals. Enter Matty Van Eck who has a small private zoo in Midrand. She had sent two lions to a reserve in the Masai Mara – and those lions were also mutilated. By November Matty decided to do something to try and at least get some information that may lead to arrests. . She sent out a WhatsApp to all lion owners and invited them to answer her questionnaire. Two things have stood out as common to all the attacks. The first is that Two step is being used and the second more curious fact is that a week before each of the attacks took place, Nature conservation officials visited the premises to do inspections. While that has not led to any arrests yet – two other people in their WhatsApp Group have taken action -Nazeer and Gert. Once before a water tight case was lost in the Koster court – there was DNA evidence and it appears the prosecutor didn’t even open the file. On Monday Gert Blom received information about the perpetrators who killed eight of his lions. He bypassed the ordinary cops in the area and brought in organised crime investigators. They set up a sting and caught some of the perpetrators whose case has been postponed. They did not get bail and are still behind bars. Even the United Nations have picked up on this story and we can speak to their lead researcher via skype – Daniel Styles.
